title: The pre-push lane refusal refuses a merge-pull of content, and misses a push by url or another remote name
goal: kbgit.py hook pre-push judges a merge commit only on what neither parent brings (a git pull --no-rebase of content over a merged code merge request is not refused) and treats a push as going to the integration remote when the remote name or its url matches the integration remote's url, as kbpublic.is_public does for the public home; TestPrePushLaneEdges in _tools/test_kblane.py plants both; found by the SP-v5xagbyv review
